prs.title: fix(bedrock): let the context probe reach models with a maxTokens floor
prs.es: fix(bedrock): let the context probe reach models with a maxTokens floor
prs.en: fix(bedrock): let the context probe reach models with a maxTokens floor

prs.title: fix(tools): report http_request timeouts with the tool's own message (TS)
prs.es: http_request (TypeScript) reporta su propio mensaje de timeout en lugar del genérico de Node.
prs.en: The TypeScript http_request tool reports its own timeout message instead of Node's generic abort error.

prs.title: fix(build): run build scripts' main() from a symlinked checkout
prs.es: Los scripts de build de Node ya corren desde un checkout con symlink (antes salían en 0 sin hacer nada).
prs.en: Node build scripts now run from a symlinked checkout (they used to exit 0 without doing anything).

prs.title: fix(gateway): give /bg the replied-to message as context
prs.es: /bg enviado como respuesta a un mensaje ahora le pasa ese mensaje al agente en segundo plano como contexto.
prs.en: /bg sent as a reply now gives the background agent the replied-to message as context.

prs.title: feat(tts): opt-in loudness normalization (tts.normalize_loudness)
prs.es: Opción tts.normalize_loudness: un pase de ffmpeg loudnorm a -16 LUFS para que cada nota de voz suene al mismo volumen.
prs.en: Opt-in tts.normalize_loudness: one ffmpeg loudnorm pass to -16 LUFS so every voice note plays at the same volume.

prs.title: fix(gateway): honor display.platforms.<platform>.memory_notifications
prs.es: El gateway respeta display.platforms.<plataforma>.memory_notifications: el aviso de memoria se puede apagar solo en WhatsApp.
prs.en: The gateway honors display.platforms.<platform>.memory_notifications, so memory notices can be turned off per platform.

issues.title: [Feature]: opt-in loudness normalization for TTS output (tts.normalize_loudness)
issues.es: Propuesta: normalización de volumen opcional para la salida de TTS (la implementa el PR #157956).
issues.en: Proposal: opt-in loudness normalization for TTS output (implemented in PR #157956).

issues.title: [Bug]: Bedrock (anthropic_messages): AWS_PROFILE + AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK in a profile crashes AnthropicBedrock with "Cannot specify both api_key and AWS credentials"
issues.es: Reporte: en Bedrock, AWS_PROFILE + AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK en un mismo perfil tumbaba el cliente AnthropicBedrock.
issues.en: Report: on Bedrock, AWS_PROFILE + AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK in one profile crashed the AnthropicBedrock client.
